Construction Services in Clearwater, KS

Clearwater is a Sedgwick County community of roughly 2,500 residents on the south edge of the Wichita metro, along US-81 in the Arkansas River valley corridor. The town has a mix of older original-plat housing near downtown and newer residential development on the outskirts, along with rural acreage properties on county roads east and west of town.

The housing stock spans several decades — older properties near downtown that need comprehensive updates, and newer construction that's aging into its first major renovation cycle. Wheatland Construction serves Clearwater and south Sedgwick County. We permit through Sedgwick County for rural properties and through the City of Clearwater for in-town work.

What We Build in Clearwater

Custom Homes

Clearwater-area rural lots on county roads south and east of town are popular with homeowners building custom homes outside the metro. We build custom homes in the Clearwater area from foundation through finish — handling Sedgwick County permits and all construction directly. See Custom Home Building in Clearwater →

Home Additions

Clearwater's housing stock includes modest-sized homes that working families have outgrown. Room additions and garage expansions are practical solutions — adding square footage to an existing home rather than buying or building new. We match existing materials and rooflines throughout. See Home Additions in Clearwater →

Basement Finishing

Clearwater-area homes frequently have unfinished basements — some original to 1950s and 1960s construction, some roughed in during the 1990s. The Arkansas River valley soil profile includes sandy loam and alluvial deposits in some areas that affect drainage behavior. We assess every basement before quoting. See Basement Finishing in Clearwater →

Bathroom Remodeling

Clearwater's older homes have original mid-century bathrooms with cast-iron plumbing and dated finishes. Newer properties have builder-grade bathrooms from the 1990s and 2000s that are reaching end of life. We remodel both — complete gut and replace with new tile, new vanity, new fixtures, and updated plumbing where needed. See Bathroom Remodeling in Clearwater →

Kitchen Remodeling

Clearwater kitchens range from original galley layouts in 1950s-era homes to larger 1990s kitchens with materials that need replacing. We handle targeted refreshes and full renovations — cabinets, countertops, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and layout reconfiguration where the original design doesn't serve how the kitchen gets used. See Kitchen Remodeling in Clearwater →

Major Remodels

Older Clearwater-area homes often need broader work — comprehensive renovation projects that go beyond a single trade or a single room. We manage major remodel scopes with full permit coordination through Sedgwick County. See Major Remodels in Clearwater →

Roofing

South Sedgwick County sees significant spring storm activity. Clearwater-area properties, particularly those on open rural routes with less windbreak, experience meaningful wind and hail exposure each season. We install roofing systems rated for Kansas storm conditions and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Clearwater →

Clearwater Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Clearwater properties permit through the City of Clearwater. Rural Sedgwick County properties permit through Sedgwick County. We handle all permit applications and inspections.
